audit_scope: Worker-4 source-reviewed DBAASP linked assay, experiment, and literature rows against primary XML/PDF evidence and packet database snapshots.
tools_attempted: rg source text search over XML/PDF/supplement text
sed PDF text windows around activity and methods sections
JSONL row reconciliation for DBAASP linked assay/experiment/literature rows

nonblocking_cautions.impact: Eight duplicate DBAASP assay/experiment rows are retained as source_conflict because the database says Staphylococcus aureus while Table 3 labels the staphylococcal columns as MRCNS and MRSA.
linked_sequence_records.jsonl is empty; compound identity is therefore reviewed from paper names/structures and database peptide names rather than a separate sequence snapshot.
